title: ITJobs Scraper: IT Jobs in Portugal
description: Scrape IT job ads from ITJobs.pt, the Portuguese tech job board: title, company, locations, remote or hybrid, salary range, posting date and, on request, the full text, contract and tags. Pay-per-result.
readme:
# ITJobs Scraper Scrape job ads from ITJobs ([itjobs.pt](https://www.itjobs.pt/)), the Portuguese board for IT and tech jobs. You get the title, company, locations, the work model (on site, remote or hybrid), the salary range when the ad shows one, the posting date and the HOT and featured badges for every ad. Turn on the job page option to add the full text, contract, schedule, tags, valid-through date and the company website. Search by keyword, location, work model, contract, schedule, minimum salary and age of the ad. ## What you get - One row per ad, with parsed salary numbers (from and up to, in EUR) and a clean ISO date. - Optional job page details: exact posting date, valid-through date, full description as HTML and plain text, contract type, schedule, reference, postal address data, tags and the company website. - Each ad once per run, even when several keywords or locations find it. - A run with no input returns 5 ads for the keyword java. ## Use with AI Agents (MCP) Connect this actor to any MCP-compatible AI client: Claude Desktop, Claude.ai, Cursor, VS Code, LangChain, LlamaIndex, or custom agents. **Apify MCP server URL:** `https://mcp.apify.com?tools=santamaria-automations/itjobs-pt-jobs-scraper` **Example prompt once connected:** > "Use `itjobs-pt-jobs-scraper` to find up to 5 jobs for the keyword "java" (developer roles in Lisbon). Return results as a table with title, company, location and job URL." Clients that support dynamic tool discovery (Claude.ai, VS Code) receive the full input schema automatically. ## Input Every field is optional. Example: ```json { "includeDetails": false, "maxResults": 5, "maxResultsPerQuery": 5, "searchQueries": [ "java" ] } ``` | Field | What it does | |---|---| | `searchQueries` | Keywords such as java, python, devops or product owner. Each keyword is its own search. | | `locations` | Lisboa, Porto, Braga, Aveiro, Coimbra, Setubal, Leiria, Faro and the other places of the site, or International. Names with or without accents work. | | `workModels` | Presencial (on site), Remoto (remote) or Hibrido (hybrid). | | `contractTypes` | Contrato sem termo, Contrato a termo, Prestacao de Servicos or Estagio profissional. permanent, fixed-term, freelance and internship work too. | | `schedules` | Full-time or Part-time. | | `minSalary` | Only ads with a salary above this yearly amount in EUR. The site works in steps of 10 000 up to 60 000, then 100 000; the next lower step is used. 0 means no filter. | | `postedWithin` | 24h, 7d or 15d. | | `sortBy` | relevance or date, for keyword searches. | | `maxResultsPerQuery` | Ads per keyword and filter combination. Default 50, up to 1000. | | `maxResults` | Ads in total. 0 means no limit. | | `includeDetails` | Read each job page for the extra fields. Default false. | ## Sample output ```json { "id": "518759", "title": "Técnico de Sistemas IT - Field | Licenciatura em Informática + Microsoft AI", "slug": "tecnico-de-sistemas-it-field-licenciatura-em-informatica-microsoft-ai", "company": "Compuworks", "company_slug": "compuworks", "company_url": "https://www.itjobs.pt/empresa/compuworks", "company_logo": "https://static.itjobs.pt/images/companies/0f/49c/283/logo.png?btfc=1787306453", "company_website": "http://www.compuworks.pt/", "location": "Lisboa", "locations": [ "Lisboa" ], "region": "Lisboa", "postal_code": "1000-001", "country": "PT", "work_model": "Presencial", "remote": false, "hybrid": false, "contract_type": "Contrato a termo", "schedule": "Full-time", "employment_types": [ "FULL_TIME", "TEMPORARY" ], "salary_text": "€20 000 - €40 000", "salary_min": 20000, "salary_max": 40000, "salary_currency": "EUR", "reference": "Tec IT Licenciado", "posted_text": "3 Nov", "date_posted": "2026-11-03", "valid_through": "2026-12-03T10:51:46+00:00", "hot": true, "featured": true, "tags": [ "ai", "microsoft" ], "description_html": "

Estamos a recrutar!

Técnico de Sistemas IT - Field | Licenciatura em Informática + Microsoft AI

A CompuWorks, empresa de referência na...", "description_text": "Estamos a recrutar!\n\nTécnico de Sistemas IT - Field | Licenciatura em Informática + Microsoft AI\n\nA CompuWorks, empresa de referência na prestação de serviços e soluções de Tecnologias de Informação, ...", "job_url": "https://www.itjobs.pt/oferta/518759/tecnico-de-sistemas-it-field-licenciatura-em-informatica-microsoft-ai", "details_fetched": true, "search_query": "java", "source": "itjobs.pt", "scraped_at": "2026-11-10T15:00:00Z" } ``` ## Fields | Field | Type | Description | |---|---|---| | `id` | string | Ad number: the number in the ad address /oferta//. It is the dedup key. | | `title` | string | Job title as shown on the ad. | | `slug` | string | Text part of the ad address. | | `company` | string, null | Hiring company as shown on the ad. | | `company_slug` | string, null | Text part of the company page address /empresa/. | | `company_url` | string, null | Company page on ITJobs with all its ads. | | `company_logo` | string, null | Logo image URL of the ad. | | `company_website` | string, null | Website of the company as given in the job posting data. Needs the job page. | | `location` | string, null | Places of the ad joined by comma. Remote ads often have none. | | `locations` | array | Places of the ad as a list (Lisboa, Porto, ...). Empty when the ad shows none. | | `region` | string, null | Region of the first job location in the job posting data. Needs the job page. | | `postal_code` | string, null | Postal code of the first job location in the job posting data. Needs the job page. | | `country` | string, null | Country code of the first job location (PT). Needs the job page. | | `work_model` | string, null | Presencial (on site), Remoto (remote) or Híbrido (hybrid), as shown on the ad. | | `remote` | boolean, null | True when the work model is Remoto. Null when the ad shows no work model. | | `hybrid` | boolean, null | True when the work model is Híbrido. Null when the ad shows no work model. | | `contract_type` | string, null | Contract of the ad, for example Contrato sem termo or Prestação de Serviços. Needs the job page. | | `schedule` | string, null | Full-time or Part-time. Needs the job page. | | `employment_types` | array | Employment type codes of the job posting data, for example FULL_TIME. Needs the job page. | | `salary_text` | string, null | Salary range as shown on the ad, for example "€20 000 - €40 000". Only some ads show one. | | `salary_min` | number, null | Lower bound of the shown salary in EUR. A single amount is both bounds. | | `salary_max` | number, null | Upper bound of the shown salary in EUR. | | `salary_currency` | string, null | Currency code of the shown salary (EUR). | | `reference` | string, null | Reference code the employer gave the ad. Needs the job page. | | `posted_text` | string, null | Date box above the ad on the list ("10 Nov"), or the date line of the job page. | | `date_posted` | string, null | Posting date as ISO date. From the job posting data with the job page, otherwise built from the date box (the year is the current one). | | `valid_through` | string, null | Date and time until which the ad is valid, ISO 8601. Needs the job page. | | `hot` | boolean | True when the ad carries the HOT (popular) badge. | | `featured` | boolean | True when the ad was shown in the "Em destaque" (featured) block of the list. | | `tags` | array | Tags of the job page. Needs the job page. | | `description_html` | string, null | Full ad text as HTML. Needs the job page. | | `description_text` | string, null | Full ad text as plain text. Needs the job page. | | `job_url` | string | Address of the ad on itjobs.pt. | | `details_fetched` | boolean | True when the job page was read for this row. | | `search_query` | string | Keyword that found the ad, or "all jobs" for a search without keyword. | | `source` | string | Site the ad comes from (itjobs.pt). | | `scraped_at` | string | Time of the scrape, ISO 8601 UTC. | ## Pricing This Actor uses pay per event. There is a small `apify-actor-start` event when a run starts and one `job-result` event for each ad in the dataset. You are never charged for an ad twice, and a run stops when it reaches the maximum charge you set. Price: $0.001 start fee per run, then $0.0012 per job result ($1.20 per 1,000 jobs). **New to Apify?** Every account gets a $5 free monthly platform credit, enough to try this actor at no cost. ## Related Actors - [Net-Empregos.pt Scraper: Portugal Jobs, Salaries and Employers](https://apify.com/santamaria-automations/net-empregos-pt-scraper): Portuguese job listings from Net-Empregos.pt. - [NoFluffJobs.com EU Scraper - Engineering Jobs & Salaries](https://apify.com/santamaria-automations/nofluffjobs-eu-scraper): Engineering jobs and salaries from NoFluffJobs. - [JustJoin.it Scraper](https://apify.com/santamaria-automations/justjoinit-scraper): IT jobs with salary ranges from JustJoin.it. - [InfoJobs Scraper - Spanish Job Listings & Salaries | $3/1K Jobs](https://apify.com/santamaria-automations/infojobs-scraper): Spanish job listings and salaries from InfoJobs. ## FAQ **Which filters can I combine?** All of them. Locations, work models, contract types and schedules accept several values: each value is read as its own search and an ad found twice is returned once. With several keywords, each keyword runs as its own search too. **Why is the salary empty for most ads?** Most employers do not state a salary on the list. Then `salary_text` and the numeric salary fields are `null`. The `minSalary` filter still works, because the site filters on the salary the employer entered. **Is the posting date exact?** With `includeDetails` on, yes: it comes from the job page. With it off, the list only shows a day and a month above each group of ads (for example "10 Nov"), so the date is built from that with the current year. Ads in the featured block carry no date until the job page is read. **What happens when a keyword finds nothing?** The run ends normally with the status "0 jobs found for ." and nothing is charged. The latest ads the site shows beside a page without matches are not returned. **Why do some ads have no location?** Some remote ads show no place on the list. Then `location` is `null` and `locations` is an empty list. ## Support Something broken, or a field you wish this Actor returned? Open a ticket on the Actor's [Issues tab](https://apify.com/santamaria-automations/itjobs-pt-jobs-scraper/issues) or email contact@nanoscrape.com. We usually respond within one working day.
